desc:
🪂 Drop in, loot up, be the last one standing!

👥 100 per match · Solo, Duo & Squad · TPP or FPP
⚡ Find a match in ~15 seconds with your party
✈️ Warm up on the staging island, jump from the plane and choose where to land
🔫 Real weapons: AKM, HK416, SCAR-L, Kar98k, M24, AWM, Mk14, Vector, UMP45 and many more
🔭 Red dot, holo, 2x to 15x scopes, grips, suppressors, stocks
🪖 Helmets, vests and backpacks (Lv.1-3), medkits, boosts, grenades, molotovs and the frying pan 🍳
🚙 Cars, motorcycles and boats, airdrops and a shrinking zone
🤝 Get knocked, get revived, spectate your team
🎖️ Earn Credits and XP, unlock outfits and weapon skins
🗺️ KOBALT: a 2.4 x 2.4 km map
🗺️ AKANE: a 2.0 x 2.0 km map

📱 PC & mobile
⚠️ BETA: things may change and bugs can happen. Your feedback helps!

[V2.0] UPDATE 26.10
- Map improvements.
- Collisions fixes.
- Bug fixes.
